observation_rule: Snapshot after test setup and before attempted command. Compare canonical object values, semantic generation, Scene revision, history cursor and redo state before vs after rejection. Excluded means non-applicable only; locked, denied, stale or unavailable are not exclusions. For a queued command invalidated before execution, compare just before execution after the intervening valid mutation, not against pre-mutation state.
